question: What is the meaning of recycled content in relation to products and materials?
description: Recycled content in relation to products and materials refers to the utilization of materials that have been previously used and processed in some form, rather than being sourced entirely from primary raw materials. This can involve incorporating recycled materials into the production of new products or components, thereby reducing the demand for virgin resources and promoting sustainability through the reuse of materials.
